panels.title: Online avg score by metric
panels.description: Online-sampled eval_scores (E5), averaged per metric_name in 1h buckets. Faithfulness/answer_relevancy/citation_validity/etc.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), metric_name, avg(score) AS avg_score FROM eval_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND source = 'online_sampled' AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, metric_name ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Online pass rate by metric
panels.description: Share of online-sampled eval_scores rows with passed = true, per metric_name, 1h buckets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), metric_name, avg(passed::int) AS pass_rate FROM eval_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND source = 'online_sampled' AND passed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, metric_name ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Offline (golden-set) avg score by metric
panels.description: GoldenSetBenchmark run history (E6), averaged per metric_name in 1h buckets -- each point is roughly one benchmark run, not continuous production traffic.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), metric_name, avg(score) AS avg_score FROM eval_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND source = 'offline_benchmark' AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, metric_name ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Score volume by source
panels.description: Row count per eval_scores.source (online_sampled / offline_benchmark / human_feedback), 1d buckets -- a volume/coverage check, not a quality metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), source, count(*) AS row_count FROM eval_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, source ORDER BY 1
